scenarios.scenario: Retain the selected customization tab after reopening

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software with Sketch1 being edited
the customization dialog is open on the Marking Menu tab with no pending edits
a part with an active sketch is open in the MCAD Software
this is the same application session in which Marking Menu was previously selected
the user selects the "Keyboard" tab
the user closes the customization dialog
the user opens Customize again from the Tools Options panel
the customization dialog opens on the "Keyboard" tab
no keyboard or ribbon changes are pending
the user closes the customization dialog
the active sketch remains unchanged
